_comment: Category tiers shared by the review and import scripts (not part of the page). 2026-10-04: these lists used to be written separately in review_checklist.py, verify_sheet.py and research_merge.py, and 'the reference city's categories' was the only coverage standard, so every new city had to re-justify skipping the same commercial categories. See docs/guides/新城市扩展方法论与标准.md §8.
_safety: Safety-critical: verified first, phone-checked before launch, never shown as an approximate position. Order = review order.
_ownPin: research_merge.py never folds these into another record at the same address (a shelter is never a footnote). Same as safety minus gov — the original rule; the reason for leaving gov out was not recorded, confirm before changing.
_commercialOptional: Commercial places any map app lists, that change often and that no official source vouches for. A new city may leave them out without explaining (Kelowna did, with these reasons: import/config.json categoriesNotCollected).
_noOfficialHours: Left out of the 'share with opening hours' comparison: open-air places (CITY.openAir) have none, and the government datasets for child care and schools carry none.
